title: Macroscopic Poincaré Inequalities and Weak-Type Characterizations of $p$-Energy Forms
summary: For a class of regular strongly local $p$-energy forms on complete doubling metric measure spaces, $1<p<\infty$, we derive a macroscopic Poincaré inequality from a Poincaré inequality and a capacity upper bound at a doubling scale $Ψ$. The macroscopic inequality compares $L^p$-oscillations at any two scales and yields a uniform two-scale comparison $J_s\lesssim J_r$, $0<r<s$, for the Korevaar-Schoen functionals, strengthening their usual weak monotonicity property.
